subTitleDesc.sub_title:
針對市場上不同經營規模之商業經營者之商業策略、商業模式、行銷策略、市場定位進行探討及分析。課程主題包括商業策略、商業模式、行銷策略、市場定位、行銷商戰概念的實踐應用，並透過AI工具的學習及應用，以提升學生商業及行銷之專業實務技能。
The course explores and analyzes business strategies, business models, marketing strategies, and market positioning for business operators of different scales. Course topics include business strategy, business models, marketing strategies, market positioning, and the practical application of marketing warfare concepts. Additionally, the course incorporates the learning and application of AI tools to enhance students' professional and practical skills in business and marketing.
subTitleDesc.sub_title_en: The course explores and analyzes business strategies, business models, marketing strategies, and market positioning for business operators of different scales. Course topics include business strategy, business models, marketing strategies, market positioning, and the practical application of marketing warfare concepts. Additionally, the course incorporates the learning and application of AI tools to enhance students' professional and practical skills in business and marketing.
subTitleDesc.sub_describe:
商業經營者皆有其市場生存之道，如商業策略、商業模式、行銷策略、市場定位等等，本課程將針對不同經營規模(大品牌、中品牌、個體戶)之商業經營者進行研究及分析，以了解在市場嚴峻競爭之下，不同經營規模之商業經營者在行銷商戰運用之優劣勢，並透過AI工具的學習及應用，提升學生商業及行銷之專業實務技能，進而提升學生面對行銷就業市場的專業技能及競爭力。
All business operators have their own ways of surviving in the market, such as business strategies, business models, marketing strategies, and market positioning. This course will study and analyze business operators of different scales (large brands, medium-sized brands, and individual businesses) to understand their strengths and weaknesses in marketing warfare under intense market competition. Through the learning and application of AI tools, the course aims to enhance students' professional and practical skills in business and marketing, ultimately improving their expertise and competitiveness in the marketing job market.
subTitleDesc.sub_describe_en: All business operators have their own ways of surviving in the market, such as business strategies, business models, marketing strategies, and market positioning. This course will study and analyze business operators of different scales (large brands, medium-sized brands, and individual businesses) to understand their strengths and weaknesses in marketing warfare under intense market competition. Through the learning and application of AI tools, the course aims to enhance students' professional and practical skills in business and marketing, ultimately improving their expertise and competitiveness in the marketing job market.

description.describe_ch: 探討『行銷商戰與定位』的重要性，教導學生如何透過市場分析和消費者行為制定有效的行銷策略。課程主題包括行銷商戰概念、市場定位、品牌策略以及行銷策略的實踐應用。
description.describe_eh: Explores the importance of marketing warfare and positioning, teaching students how to develop effective marketing strategies. Topics covered include marketing warfare concepts, market positioning, branding strategy, and the practical application of marketing strategies.

targets.describe_ch: 學生具備行銷商戰的概念
